quests.title: The Cahow Count
quests.summary: The cahow was lost for three hundred years. Help the warden on Nonsuch count the burrows, show her a cahowl, and see off an egg collector.

steps.text: Check the burrow marker on the beach by the Moongate.
Check the burrow marker on the Dockyard shore.
Check the burrow marker on the Crystal Caves path.
Catch a cahowl (it turns up on the grass, shy) and show the warden.
Face the egg collector on the bar to Nonsuch, then tell the warden.

quests.reward: A Longtail Feather (a charm: gale moves hurt less) and the warden's thanks.
